scripts.start: cross-env HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run start:happ:mem" "sleep 5 && npm run start:ui"
scripts.start:happ:mem: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate ../../secret.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a hSecret network mem
scripts.package: rm -rf ui.zip && cd dist && bestzip ../ui.zip * && cd .. && hc web-app pack ./webhapp.workdir
